description: CRITERIA-3D is an agro-hydrological model published by Arpae Emilia-Romagna for small and medium-sized catchments. It couples three-dimensional surface and subsurface water flow with soil heat transport, crop water uptake, snow and slope-stability calculations. Inputs include terrain and soil configurations plus hourly temperature, precipitation, radiation, humidity and wind. Outputs represent water and heat movement and associated catchment conditions over user-selected domains and periods. Public C++/Qt source is free under GPL-3.0 for applications, with separately identified LGPL libraries, and supports CPU parallelism or optional NVIDIA CUDA. A limitation is that the forestry biomass component is still in development, while dedicated irrigation scheduling is handled by the separate CRITERIA-1D model. The README illustrates the Ravone catchment near Bologna but does not by itself establish a reusable standalone case-study package. CRITERIA-3D supports flood, drainage and slope-risk simulations, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). Build instructions and scientific references describe the numerical basis. No binaries, catchment files or meteorological data were downloaded.
